Status

FinKore Core 2.0.4 stable.

Purpose

This document defines currency identity and compatibility for Money values that use ISO 4217 identifiers in Core 2.0.

Requirements

  • MONEY-CURRENCY-001 — A currency identifier MUST be non-empty and unambiguous within its declared context.
  • MONEY-CURRENCY-002 — Currency identifiers SHOULD use ISO 4217 alphabetic codes when representing currencies covered by ISO 4217.
  • MONEY-CURRENCY-003 — Within this document's normative scope, two Money values MUST be considered currency-compatible only when they use the same ISO 4217 currency identifier.
  • MONEY-CURRENCY-004 — Operations that require currency compatibility MUST fail with FINKORE_MONEY_CURRENCY_MISMATCH when currencies are incompatible. Conversion is a separate explicit operation outside this specification.
  • MONEY-CURRENCY-005 — Currency metadata MUST NOT be treated as an exchange rate.

The uppercase rule for ISO 4217 identifiers is SPEC-CURRENCY-002 in Specification Conventions.

Invariants

A Money operation other than explicit conversion does not change currency; see MONEY-ARITHMETIC-002 through MONEY-ARITHMETIC-005.

Examples

EUR and EUR are compatible. EUR and USD are not compatible.

Invalid Examples

  • Treating all dollar-named currencies as compatible.
  • Relabeling 10 USD as 10 EUR without conversion.

Errors

The applicable failure conditions are defined in Money Errors.

Open Questions

  • Should a future FinKore specification define a namespace for application-defined or non-ISO currency identifiers?

Non-Goals

This document does not define exchange rates, redenomination, currency availability dates, or display symbols. Application-defined currencies, crypto assets, tokens, loyalty points, internal credits, and other non-ISO identifiers are outside the normative scope of Core 2.0; this exclusion does not prohibit a composing application from supporting them.
